sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Shivjee Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sunil Kumar Pandey, A.P.P.
 Mr. RK Jha, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 20-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that both parties have resolved and settled their dispute in terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them.
A copy of the settlement is annexed with the mediator's report dated 17.2.2026.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner.
5. Considering the mediator's report, prayer for bail of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24916 of 2025(4) dt.20-02-2026 the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate I, Danapur, Patna in Danapur Police Station Case No. 96/2014,
